Name: Gedaliah, Son of Jeduthun
Summary: Son of Jeduthun who prophesied with a harp, second lot.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 25:3; 1 Chronicles 25:9: Son of Jeduthun who prophesied with a harp, second lot.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Gedaliah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
